test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 12 July 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: A 900 metre long train crosses a 1200 metres long platform completely in 70 seconds. What is the speed of the train?
solution:
**Given:**

A 900 metre long train crosses a 1200 metres long platform entirely in 70 seconds

**Concept used:**

Speed = Distance/Time

When a train crosses a platform, it will cover the length of its own + the length of the platform.

**Calculation:**

Total distance covered = 900 + 1200

⇒ 2100

Speed = 2100/70

⇒ 30 m/sec

Now,

Speed in km/h = 30 × (18/5)

⇒ 108

**∴ The speed of the train is 108 km/h.**
